title: /alerts calls itself "the full queue of everything requiring action" and shows 4 items while the dashboard that links to it counts 6 attention types and 23 open queue tasks — with almost no overlap
evidence: out/dashboard/01-dashboard-text.txt vs out/dashboard/04-alerts.txt and out/dashboard/04-alerts-top.png (2026-09-04 00:35). Dashboard דורש טיפול היום = 6 rows: 2 payment requests overdue / 9 open exceptions (3 high) / 2 late deliveries / 1 invoice pending approval / 2 payment requests pending approval / 5 orders awaiting supplier confirmation. Dashboard משימות לפי תפקיד = 23 open tasks across 6 queues, and its corner arrow links to /alerts (Dashboard.tsx:271, aria-label on that arrow); the top-bar bell and the nav item lead there too — three /alerts anchors in out/dashboard/01-dashboard-links.json. /alerts דורש טיפול lists only 4: 1 duplicate invoice numbers / 2 payment requests past due / 5 orders sent not yet confirmed / 5 invoices with no linked purchase order. Only 'orders awaiting confirmation' and 'payments overdue' appear on both. Open exceptions (9, 3 high), invoices pending approval, payment requests pending approval, late deliveries, invoices to review, PR drafts and invoices not yet sent to the accountant appear on NO version of /alerts. src/lib/alerts.ts:213-218 registers exactly six scans and none of them covers those states. Note for labelling: git shows this divergence predates PR #244 (alerts.ts changed by only 4 lines in the wave merge) — it is a gap the deploy's dashboard re-plumbing (0299/0300/0304) did not close, not code that just shipped.
repro: Sign in as owner → /dashboard → read דורש טיפול היום (6) and משימות לפי תפקיד (23) → click the arrow in the corner of the dark queue card → /alerts.
expected: One answer to 'what needs attention'. Either /alerts covers everything the dashboard counts, or its subtitle stops claiming to be the full queue and names what it does not scan (it already names three uncovered scans, so the mechanism exists).
actual: Three surfaces give three different answers (6 / 23 / 4), and the one that claims completeness is the smallest and omits every exception in the tenant.

title: Every on-time percentage on /analytics is drawn from 1–2 receipts, on a screen whose own header says the metric is shown only after at least 5
evidence: out/dashboard/04-analytics-top.png and out/dashboard/04-analytics.txt show the header '21 ספקים · עמידה בזמנים מוצגת לאחר 5 קבלות לפחות לספק' and a עמידה בזמנים column reading 100% / 50% / 100% / 100% / 100%. The supplier_metrics response captured on that page load (out/dashboard/09-supplier-metrics.json) has 22 rows; exactly 9 carry a non-null on_time_pct and ALL 9 have otd_samples < 5 — seven have otd_samples=1, two have otd_samples=2. Worst case: supplier aa000000-...-0001 (משק ירוק — ירקות ופירות, out/dashboard/09-analytics-page2.txt) is printed as '0%' on-time from one delivery. src/pages/Analytics.tsx:19-23 gates only the COLOUR on otd_samples>=5 (otdTone returns 'idle'); the value itself is rendered unconditionally by fmtPct at line 57.
repro: Sign in as owner → /analytics → compare the header sentence with the עמידה בזמנים column; page 2 shows the 0%.
expected: Below 5 samples the cell shows —, as the header promises. Zero is a claim about reality and 0% from one delivery is a verdict on a supplier.
actual: Nine percentages are printed, none of them from 5 or more receipts; the threshold affects only the text colour.

title: The ₪11,582 open-invoice-balance tile lands on a list that excludes the ₪150 partially-paid invoice inside that figure and includes a $300 invoice that is not
evidence: Tile: 'יתרת חשבוניות פתוחות ₪11,582 · 8 חשבוניות פתוחות', currency picker on ILS (out/dashboard/10-tile-open-balance.png, out/dashboard/01-dashboard-text.txt). Destination /invoices?pay=unpaid: '8 חשבוניות', 7 in ILS summing 11+90+780+3,540+4,720+1,650.60+640 = ₪11,431.60, plus QA-USD-001 at $300 (out/dashboard/tiles/open-balance.txt, out/dashboard/10-invoices-pay-unpaid.png). /invoices?pay=open returns 9 rows: the same 8 plus invoice 3377 אריזות הדרום, total ₪900, balance ₪150, status שולמה חלקית (out/dashboard/10-invoices-pay-open.txt). 11,431.60 + 150.00 = ₪11,581.60, which is the tile's ₪11,582, and the ILS row count there is 8, which is the tile's count. src/pages/Invoices.tsx:180-183: pay=unpaid is payment_status = 'unpaid' exactly; pay=open is payment_status != 'paid'. The link (Dashboard.tsx:1239) uses pay=unpaid and carries no currency.
repro: Sign in as owner → /dashboard → click the יתרת חשבוניות פתוחות card → add the יתרה column values. Then open /invoices?pay=open and add them again.
expected: The tile opens the population it counted: pay=open, and narrowed to the currency the picker is on.
actual: A manager auditing ₪11,582 finds ₪11,431.60 of ILS balance, a dollar invoice that is not part of the figure, and no sign of the ₪150 that closes the gap.

title: "2 הזמנות באיחור באספקה" opens a list of 9 with no way to isolate the 2
evidence: out/dashboard/01-dashboard-links.json: '/receiving | 2 הזמנות באיחור באספקה'. Destination header (out/dashboard/10-receiving-9-orders.png, out/dashboard/tiles/late-delivery.txt): '9 הזמנות ממתינות · 5 דורשות פעולה'. The same URL is also the destination of the role-queue row that correctly says 9. /receiving's only filter is by status (src/pages/Receiving.tsx reads no filter params at all — only ?document); nothing there filters on a past expected_date, and only orders #11 (18.07.2026) and #12 (20.07.2026) actually carry one. Dashboard.tsx:912 { key: 'late-delivery', ... to: '/receiving' }. The wave-0-8 audit rewrote the six RoleQueueCard links to spell the snapshot's predicate (Dashboard.tsx:243-262) and left this attention row pointing at the nearest screen.
repro: Sign in as owner → /dashboard → click '2 הזמנות באיחור באספקה'.
expected: A list holding the 2 orders whose expected delivery date has passed.
actual: Nine orders, two numbers (2 and 9) pointing at the same URL, and no filter that reproduces the 2.

title: "7 הזמנות פתוחות ללא תאריך אספקה" opens the whole order list — 254 rows
evidence: out/dashboard/01-dashboard-links.json: '/orders | 7 הזמנות פתוחות ללא תאריך אספקה' (Dashboard.tsx:344, bare <Link to="/orders">). Destination header (out/dashboard/10-orders-default.png): '254 הזמנות בתצוגה · 270 בסך הכול', filter הזמנות פתוחות. src/pages/Orders.tsx:98-112 supports only ?status= (single, comma set, 'open' or 'all') — there is no undated filter. The 7 are visible at /orders?status=sent,confirmed,partial, where 7 of the 9 rows show אספקה = — (out/dashboard/tiles/commitments.txt), so the correct narrower destination already exists and is used by the neighbouring התחייבויות פתוחות row.
repro: Sign in as owner → /dashboard → click '7 הזמנות פתוחות ללא תאריך אספקה'.
expected: A list from which the 7 undated open orders can be found — at minimum ?status=sent,confirmed,partial.
actual: 254 orders across 17 pages; the reader has to hunt the 7 by eye.

title: "נרכש החודש ₪2,353" opens every order the tenant has ever placed
evidence: out/dashboard/01-dashboard-links.json: '/orders?status=all | נרכש החודש ₪2,353 -59% 1–4.9 מול 1–4.8 · הזמנות שנשלחו' (Dashboard.tsx:1257). Destination header (out/dashboard/tiles/purchased-month.txt): '269 הזמנות בתצוגה · 269 בסך הכול' — no month scoping and no status scoping. The sibling tile does this correctly: שולם לספקים החודש ₪1,124 → /payments?month=2026-09, which returns exactly the 4 payments that add to ₪1,124 (out/dashboard/tiles/paid-month.txt). /orders accepts no month parameter.
repro: Sign in as owner → /dashboard → click the נרכש החודש card.
expected: The orders that make up ₪2,353 this month — the same treatment /payments?month= already gets.
actual: 269 orders across all time and all statuses; the ₪2,353 cannot be checked from the screen it opens.

title: The product purchase summary produces no cost at all — הוצאה, מחיר יחידה ממוצע and חויב are empty for all 115 products over nine months, with no message saying why
evidence: get_product_purchase_summary response for 2026-01-01→2026-09-04 (out/dashboard/09-product-summary-shape.json): 115 products, unmapped_invoice_lines = 0, unmapped_invoice_amount_by_currency = []; every sampled row has invoice_count 0, invoiced_qty null, gross_amount_by_currency null, average_unit_price null. The downloaded export for 2026-06-01→2026-09-04 (out/dashboard/downloads/products-wide__product-purchases-2026-06-01-2026-09-04.xlsx, decoded in out/dashboard/08-xlsx-dump.txt) has 115 data rows and the הוצאה ברוטו column is blank in every one; מחיר יחידה ממוצע is '—' in every one. The screen's own subtitle promises 'בדיקת הכמות והעלות שנרכשו בכל מוצר, לצד שלושת מקורות הנתונים'. src/pages/ProductPurchaseSummary.tsx:277 only renders the explanatory note when unmapped_invoice_lines > 0, which it never is, so the screen stays silent. Screenshots: out/dashboard/09-products-2026.png, out/dashboard/07-products-wide.png.
repro: Sign in as owner → /reports/products → set מתאריך 2026-01-01, עד תאריך 2026-09-04 → read the הוצאה and מחיר יחידה ממוצע columns, then export and open the file.
expected: Either a spend figure, or a sentence telling the manager why one of the three named sources is empty and what to do about it (the report already has an idiom for exactly this in the unmapped-lines note).
actual: One of the report's three declared data sources yields nothing for the entire year, silently. Root cause is not determinable from the UI — either no invoice line in this tenant references a product, or unmapped_invoice_lines is failing to count lines it should; both need a DB look.

title: The "סיכום רכישות מוצרים" link carries no month — from a July report it opens September
evidence: Switching /reports from ספטמבר to יולי updates every other tile link (out/dashboard/06-reports-links-before.json vs out/dashboard/06-reports-links-july.json: /invoices?month=2026-09 → /invoices?month=2026-07, /payments?month=2026-09 → ?month=2026-07, /bank?month=..., /credits?month=... all follow). '/reports/products' is identical in both dumps — no date parameter at all. src/pages/ProductPurchaseSummary.tsx:78-84 defaults from = first of the CURRENT month and to = today, so the July report's product link opens '19 מוצרים · 2026-09-01 עד 2026-09-04' (out/dashboard/04-reports-products.txt). Screenshot out/dashboard/06-reports-july-top.png. This is exactly the class migration 0312 ("no link beats a link to the wrong month") is named for, applied everywhere on the page except here.
repro: Sign in as owner → /reports → set the month to יולי → click 'סיכום רכישות מוצרים ←' → read the range under the title.
expected: The link carries the report's month (?from=2026-07-01&to=2026-07-31), or it is absent while a month other than the current one is selected.
actual: It silently opens the current month's 1st-to-today window, so a manager closing July looks at September and nothing says so.

title: The currency marker sits on opposite sides of the figure for ILS and USD in the same tile
evidence: Same element (a.kpi-hero inside a[href="/invoices?pay=unpaid"]), same computed direction ltr, same character sequence RLM + digits + NBSP + RLM + symbol (out/dashboard/05-money-marker.json: ILS codes 200f,31,31,2c,35,38,32,a0,200f,20aa; USD codes 200f,33,30,30,a0,200f,24). Rendered: out/dashboard/05-money-tile-ILS.png shows ₪ to the LEFT of 11,582; out/dashboard/05-money-tile-USD.png shows $ to the RIGHT of 300. Both screenshots read with the Read tool. Migration 0302 in this deploy is "a marker belongs at one end of the cell (RTL)".
repro: Sign in as owner → /dashboard → look at the יתרת חשבוניות פתוחות figure → click USD in the currency picker → look again.
expected: One marker position for every currency on a glance surface.
actual: ₪ leads, $ trails; a reader flipping the picker sees the layout shift under the same label.

title: "8 זיכויים פתוחים ₪3,381" counts a credit whose own status badge reads התקבל
evidence: Dashboard מידע נוסף tier, expanded: '8 זיכויים פתוחים ₪3,381' (out/dashboard/03-dashboard-expanded-ILS.txt). Destination /credits?status=active lists 8 rows totalling 37+1,623.60+50+450+84+390+500+246.60 = ₪3,381.20, and row #8 (חוות השדה, ₪50) carries the status התקבל (out/dashboard/tiles/credits-active.txt). src/pages/Credits.tsx:55 defines status=active as open|requested|received; src/lib/status.ts:229 marks received with tone 'done' and carries the code comment 'conflicts with checks.ts; see report'. The same ₪50 row appears as התקבל inside the accountant export's credits sheet and inside חוות השדה's ₪87.00 זיכויים פתוחים figure on /analytics.
repro: Sign in as owner → /dashboard → expand מידע נוסף → click זיכויים פתוחים → compare the row statuses with the word פתוחים.
expected: A row the product paints as done is not counted under a label that says open, or the label names the set it means.
actual: A settled credit is counted and its money added on three surfaces that all say פתוחים.

title: A non-zero saving is reported as 0%
evidence: out/dashboard/01-dashboard-text.txt and out/dashboard/01-dashboard-top.png: 'חיסוך משוער ₪9 · 0%' under נרכש החודש ₪2,353. src/pages/Dashboard.tsx:1261 renders savingsPct.toFixed(0); 9 / worst-case basket is under 0.5% and truncates to '0'.
repro: Sign in as owner → /dashboard → read the context line of the נרכש החודש card.
expected: Either a precision that can express the figure (0.4%) or no percentage beside it. 0% next to ₪9 asserts that the ₪9 is nothing.
actual: '₪9 · 0%' — the two halves of one sentence contradict each other.

title: The four action rows on /alerts are buttons, not links — no open-in-new-tab, no middle-click, on the screen that is meant to be worked through
evidence: out/dashboard/04-alerts-links.json contains no anchor into /invoices, /payment-requests or /orders; the rows are <button onClick={navigate(a.to)}> (src/pages/Alerts.tsx:143). Dashboard.tsx's AttentionZone comment (src/components/ui.tsx:1049-1050) states the opposite decision for the same kind of row — 'Rows are real <Link>s, so keyboard focus, middle-click and open in new tab all work because the dashboard is also a hub.'
repro: Sign in as owner → /alerts → middle-click any דורש טיפול row.
expected: Same affordance as the dashboard rows that link to the same places.
actual: Nothing opens; the queue can only be walked one item at a time, losing the page each time.

title: The currency choice is dropped on reload with no signal that the figures changed meaning
evidence: out/dashboard/03-dashboard-USD.txt (picker on USD: יתרת חשבוניות פתוחות $300, שולם —, נרכש —) vs out/dashboard/03-dashboard-USD-after-reload.txt after page.reload() (₪11,582 / ₪1,124 / ₪2,353). The state is not in the URL and not persisted.
repro: Sign in as owner → /dashboard → click USD → press F5.
expected: The choice survives a reload, or is in the URL so it can be shared and bookmarked — the rest of the product puts view state in query parameters.
actual: Same layout, same labels, different currency after a refresh. The caption under the picker does name the active currency, which is the only thing that prevents this from being worse.
